name: grapix
description: GrapiX broadcast graphics editor, sequencer, and renderer platform.

scripts.build:contracts: npm run build -w @grapix/shared-types && npm run build -w @grapix/stage-model && npm run build -w @grapix/surface-model && npm run build -w @grapix/tile-system && npm run build -w @grapix/scene-model && npm run build -w @grapix/animation-engine && npm run build -w @grapix/asset-manager && npm run build -w @grapix/output-contracts && npm run build -w @grapix/renderer-contracts && npm run build -w @grapix/shader-library && npm run build -w @grapix/render-protocol
scripts.test:contracts: npm test -w @grapix/stage-model && npm test -w @grapix/surface-model && npm test -w @grapix/tile-system && npm test -w @grapix/scene-model && npm test -w @grapix/animation-engine && npm test -w @grapix/asset-manager && npm test -w @grapix/output-contracts && npm test -w @grapix/renderer-contracts && npm test -w @grapix/shader-library && npm test -w @grapix/render-protocol
scripts.certify:e2e: npm run build -w @grapix/shared-types && npm run build -w @grapix/sdk && npm run build -w @grapix/renderer-protocol && npm run build -w @grapix/api-server && cargo build --manifest-path services/render-daemon/Cargo.toml && node tools/certification/run-local-e2e.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @grapix/sdk && npm run build -w @grapix/renderer-protocol && npm run build -w @grapix/api-server && npm run build -w @grapix/editor-web && npm run build -w @grapix/desktop-electron && npm run build -w @grapix/playout-control && npm run build -w @grapix/playout-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @grapix/sdk && npm run build -w @grapix/renderer-protocol && npm run typecheck -w @grapix/api-server && npm run typecheck -w @grapix/editor-web && npm run typecheck -w @grapix/desktop-electron && npm run check -w @grapix/desktop-tauri && npm run typecheck -w @grapix/playout-control && npm run typecheck -w @grapix/playout-web
